p1: [low, ominous] A serial killer mailed this code to a newspaper. [low, tense] It took fifty-one years... to read it.
[low] Northern California. [low, cold] Five people killed.
[low, tense] Then letters arrived at newspapers. [whispers] Signed with a crosshair.
[low] He called himself... the Zodiac. [low, ominous] He claimed thirty-seven victims.
[low] November, nineteen sixty-nine. He sent the San Francisco Chronicle three hundred and forty symbols.
[low, tense] Nobody could read it. [whispers] Until December, twenty twenty.
[low] Three amateur codebreakers. In America, Australia and Belgium.
[low, tense] They cracked it. The FBI confirmed it.
[low] It begins: [whispers] I hope you are having lots of fun... in trying to catch me.
[low, cold] Then: I am not afraid of the gas chamber... [whispers] because I now have enough slaves to work for me.
[low, ominous] The Zodiac was never caught. [low] Never identified.
[low, tense] And one of his ciphers is still unsolved. Thirteen symbols. After the words... [whispers] My name is.
